name: linkedin
description: Official LinkedIn API CLI and library plus an MCP server that is capability-only by default: it lists no LinkedIn operations until the experimental option is on. While enabled, read and write operations become visible, and writes only prepare a payload that the operator approves and executes in the separate CLI.

experimental.title: Enable experimental operations
experimental.description: LinkedIn operations (reads and writes) are listed only while this option is on; by default the server is capability-only and exposes no LinkedIn operations. The option reaches the server as LINKEDIN_EXPERIMENTAL (the boolean is substituted as the string 'true' or 'false'; the gate accepts true or 1, anything else stays off). Writes always still require separate operator approval in the CLI. Unofficial access can restrict the LinkedIn account; turn this on only when you know you want it.
